title: Routing rules
description: Redirects, rewrites and headers this site was published with. They come from the _redirects and _headers files in the published directory and from app.yaml, and they change only when you deploy.
loadFailed: Could not load the routing rules.

notStatic.title: This app is not a static site
notStatic.description: Routing rules apply to apps built with build.type: static. Container apps use the traffic controls on the Domains page.

notPublished.title: Published before routing rules existed
notPublished.description: Deploy this site again to enable _redirects, _headers and the SPA, clean URL and 404 options. Nothing is lost: the site keeps serving its files as before.

precedence.title: Order of evaluation
precedence.body: Rules run first, in order, and the first match wins. A rule is skipped when a file exists at the requested path unless it is forced with !. Then files are served, then the single page app fallback, then the 404 page.

empty.title: No redirect or rewrite rules
empty.description: Add a _redirects file to the published directory, or a routes list to app.yaml, and deploy.

empty.title: No header rules
empty.description: Add a _headers file to the published directory, or a headers list to app.yaml, and deploy.

problems.title: Problems found when this deploy was published
problems.description: These lines were skipped and are not applied. Fix them in your repository and deploy again.

test.title: Test a URL
test.description: Run a request through the live rules and files and see which one answers it.
test.noRule: No rule matched, answered by files and options
test.invalidPath: Enter a path that starts with /

lint.title: Check rules before deploying
lint.description: Paste the contents of a _redirects or _headers file to see how it parses. Nothing is deployed.
lint.ok: {{rules}} rules and {{headers}} header blocks parsed with no problems.
lint.withProblems: {{rules}} rules and {{headers}} header blocks parsed, {{problems}} lines skipped.
